name: Listening
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of listening with discernment and humility, urging believers to incline their ears toward wisdom and understanding rather than folly. The Proverbs passages reveal that careful listening leads to safety, wisdom, and quietness from fear, while premature answers or hearkening to misleading instruction bring shame and error. True listening involves receiving counsel and instruction that guide one toward godly knowledge, highlighting the need to listen attentively to God, others, and the messages we allow into our hearts.
